from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, os
DEST=Path('/tmp/phantom-source-snapshot-20261026T092647Z.tar.gz')
PART=Path(str(DEST)+'.part')
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_PUT(self):
        if self.path != '/snapshot' or DEST.exists() or PART.exists():
            self.send_error(409, 'unexpected path or destination already exists'); return
        try:
            n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
            if n<=0 or n>20_000_000: raise ValueError('invalid transfer size')
            expected=self.headers.get('X-Content-SHA256','')
            if len(expected)!=64: raise ValueError('missing checksum')
            fd=os.open(PART, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
            h=hashlib.sha256(); remaining=n
            with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
                while remaining:
                    chunk=self.rfile.read(min(1024*1024,remaining))
                    if not chunk: raise ValueError('short body')
                    f.write(chunk); h.update(chunk); remaining-=len(chunk)
                f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
            actual=h.hexdigest()
            if actual != expected: raise ValueError('checksum mismatch')
            os.link(PART,DEST); PART.unlink()
            body=f'ok sha256={actual} bytes={n}\n'.encode()
            self.send_response(201); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
        except Exception as e:
            try: PART.unlink()
            except FileNotFoundError: pass
            self.send_error(400,str(e))
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print(fmt % args, flush=True)
HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',18765),H).serve_forever()
